title: MemDelta: Controlled Baselines and Hidden Confounds in Agent Memory Evaluation
title_zh: MemDelta：Agent Memory 评测中的受控基线与隐藏混杂因素
abstract_en: Agent memory systems are increasingly evaluated against RAG and full-context baselines, but reported gains often mix changes in the memory method with changes in the language model, embedding model, or retrieval pipeline, making it unclear what is actually being measured. We present MemDelta, a controlled evaluation protocol that varies one component at a time on LongMemEval-S (500 questions, 50+ sessions, three model families). Four findings emerge: (1) verbatim RAG matches full-context GPT-4o-mini (47.2% vs. 49.8%, p = 0.34), but the ranking reverses across models: Gemini gains +14pp from full context, while Sonnet gains +31pp from RAG, partly because it refuses 63% of full-context queries; (2) swapping only the embedding model in an identical pipeline shifts accuracy by +6.2pp at n = 500 (p = 0.004), and Mem0 beats MiniLM-RAG by +11pp but loses to cloud-RAG by 1.2pp, so one variable flips the conclusion; (3) agent self-memory (42%) underperforms basic retrieval (47%); (4) on 2 of 6 question types (n = 88), Mem0 matches cloud RAG (72.7% vs. 73.9%, p = 1.0) at 50x the cost, suggesting narrow rather than general gains. We recommend memory evaluations fix embedding models across comparisons, stratify by model family, and report write-path cost before attributing gains to architecture.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 MemDelta，一个用于评估 Agent memory systems 的受控协议，旨在解决当前 memory 方法与 RAG、full-context baseline 对比时常见的混杂问题：性能提升可能来自语言模型、embedding model 或 retrieval pipeline 的变化，而非 memory 架构本身。MemDelta 在 LongMemEval-S 上逐一改变组件进行实验，覆盖 500 个问题、50+ 会话和三个模型家族。研究发现：verbatim RAG 与 full-context GPT-4o-mini 表现接近，但不同模型家族上的排序会反转；仅替换 embedding model 就能显著改变准确率，并可能翻转 Mem0 与 RAG 的结论；agent self-memory 低于基础 retrieval；Mem0 只在部分问题类型上接近 cloud RAG，但成本高出约 50 倍。作者建议 memory evaluation 应固定 embedding model、按模型家族分层报告，并明确 write-path cost，再将收益归因于架构设计。
key_points_zh: MemDelta 强调“一次只改变一个组件”，避免将语言模型、embedding model、retrieval pipeline 的差异误判为 memory 架构收益。
在 LongMemEval-S 上，verbatim RAG 与 full-context GPT-4o-mini 差异不显著，但 Gemini 和 Sonnet 的结果方向相反，说明模型家族会显著影响结论。
仅替换 embedding model 就可带来 +6.2pp 的准确率变化；Mem0 相比 MiniLM-RAG 有优势，但略低于 cloud-RAG，单一变量即可翻转结论。
agent self-memory 的准确率为 42%，低于基础 retrieval 的 47%，说明更复杂的自记忆机制并不必然优于简单检索。
Mem0 仅在部分问题类型上接近 cloud RAG，且成本约为 50 倍，提示其收益可能是局部而非通用的。

llm_assessment.comment: A useful generic agent-memory evaluation paper, but it has little direct grounding in e-commerce search, recommendation, or shopping-agent workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇有用的通用智能体记忆评测论文，但与电商搜索、推荐或购物智能体流程的直接关联较弱。
